verdict.rationale: Datadog's API docs point to official client libraries, with code examples in each endpoint and Maven install instructions. It also ships official Agent Observability SDKs for Python, Node.js, Java and Go (experimental), offering automatic and manual instrumentation APIs. missing for 10: an explicit list of supported languages for the general API client libraries, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and a non-experimental Go SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Select one of our official [client libraries](/extend/community/libraries/) languages in each endpoint to see code examples from that library.
SDKs are available for Python, Node.js, Java, and Go (experimental).
Agent Observability SDKs provide automatic instrumentation as well as manual instrumentation APIs to provide observability and insights into your LLM applications.
